restartInterpretation: One completed game retained unchanged; unsaved in-flight games requeued after transport-only validation failure. No evidence of outcome-based task changes or restarts; all planned games are included.
intervalSemantics: Descriptive ordinary two-sided 95% paired t intervals across 32 independent setup seeds. Report lowerBound fields instead use one-sided alpha .05 and are distinct from ci95 endpoints.
recommendation: Do not promote NN. The real model shows no observed win-share advantage over the identical-shape zero-output control, with substantial uncertainty: this is absence of evidence, not equivalence. Positive point-estimate score margin is also inconclusive.
scopeLimit: Artifact audit verifies stored IDs/hashes/counters and preserved receipts; it cannot retrospectively prove process behavior beyond the retained audit evidence. No replay, training, or new game was run.

scoreTieCaveat.reason: Rules break equal-score ties by leftover food. These two recorded decisive win shares are legal; no final food vector is retained to independently recompute this tiebreak. Paired win share is recomputed from recorded rule-engine outcomes, not score-margin sign.

completionEvidence.caveat: Filesystem modification timestamps corroborate completion; original deadline is also retained by resume receipt and finished checkpoint.
